prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal injury attorney for every car-accident case in Chicago — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, the complexity of the case, your budget and priorities (settlement vs trial, communication style, etc.). I can help you find a great match. To start, here’s a practical approach and what to look for:

Questions to clarify (so I can recommend specific attorneys):
- What ZIP code or neighborhood in Chicago are you near?  
- How serious were your injuries (minor, serious, catastrophic)?  
- Do you want a local trial attorney or someone who focuses on negotiated settlements?  
- Any language preferences or other needs?

How to find top personal injury attorneys in Chicago
- Use reputable lawyer directories: Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, and Avvo list ratings, peer reviews and practice area details.  
- Chicago Bar Association / Illinois State Bar Association lawyer referral services for screened attorneys.  
- Look at client reviews (Google, Yelp) but weigh them against peer ratings and verified case results.  
- Ask friends/family or medical providers for referrals.

What to check about any attorney
- Experience: how many car-accident cases they handle and how long they’ve practiced.  
- Track record: settlements/verdicts for similar injury types (ask for recent examples).  
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but a lawyer who can and will try a case is valuable leverage.  
- Fee structure: most personal injury lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Confirm percentage and who pays expenses if you lose.  
- Communication: who you’ll contact, typical response time, and whether they’ll keep you updated.  
- Availability: are they overloaded with cases?  
- Client references or testimonials, if available.  
- Professional standing: any disciplinary history (check the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission).

What to ask at a free consultation
- “Have you handled cases like mine? What were the outcomes?”  
- “Who will handle my case day-to-day?”  
- “What is your fee/expense arrangement?”  
- “What timeline and recovery amount do you expect?”  
- “Do you have trial experience in Cook County courts?”

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific result.  
- Pressure to sign immediately.  
- Poor communication in the intake process.  
- No contingency fee or unclear billing.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of highly-rated Chicago personal injury attorneys/firms (I’ll need your ZIP or neighborhood), or  
- Pull recent top-rated attorneys from Super Lawyers/Avvo and summarize their specialties and contact info.

Which would you prefer?
